title: Plumbing Basics: Supply, Drainage, and Dry Verification
markdown:
# RCS Day 4 - Plumbing Basics: Supply, Drainage, and Dry Verification
CTS Cohort 6 | CTS Day 12 | 2026-07-23 | 10:00 AM-3:00 PM

## Core rule
A professional does not guess. A professional checks, protects, and verifies.

## Big idea
Water follows pressure and gravity; reliable plumbing depends on correct parts, alignment, slope, seals, access, and verification.

## Architecture of the day
| Time | Instructor move |
|---|---|
| 10:00-10:15 | Arrival, PPE, retrieval warm-up |
| 10:15-10:30 | Morning quiz |
| 10:30-10:50 | Quiz review and system-path check |
| 10:50-11:20 | Supply and DWV system mapping |
| 11:20-12:00 | P-trap parts, washer, and alignment demonstration |
| 12:00-12:30 | Dry-verification guided practice and lab release |
| 12:30-1:00 | Lunch and controlled reset |
| 1:00-2:25 | Rolling-sink module rebuild and capstone pathway lab |
| 2:25-2:45 | Fault-find, dry recheck, evidence, cleanup |
| 2:45-3:00 | Exit ticket and Day 5 preview |

## Learning targets
- Differentiate supply and drain-waste-vent functions
- Explain fixture, trap, and shutoff roles
- Plan a training plumbing path through framing
- Assemble and troubleshoot a dry rolling-sink/P-trap module

## Materials and setup
- Rolling-sink and P-trap training modules with complete parts inventories
- Tailpieces, trap arms, slip nuts, correctly sized washers, and replacement parts
- Supply/DWV system maps and capstone coordination drawings
- Dry inspection trays, towels, and unexpected-moisture controls
- Separate plumbing work zone with no electrical cords or test sources
- Evidence camera or approved device

## Instructor talking points
- Use RCS01 rolling-sink experience as retrieval, then deepen system mapping.
- Trace supply -> shutoff -> fixture and fixture -> tailpiece -> P-trap -> drain outlet.
- Explain trap seal purpose without claiming a dry classroom mock-up proves code compliance.
- Demonstrate washer orientation, hand-tight alignment, accessible joints, dry inspection, and one-change-at-a-time troubleshooting.
- Coordinate plumbing paths with framing and electrical zones using the approved training drawing.
